blind.description: A stylized historical ballgown displayed on a headless dress form. The mannequin features a fabric-covered torso topped with a rounded metallic bronze/copper finial. The gown is a rich crimson red with short puffed sleeves trimmed in cream frills, a square-cut bodice with golden piping, sculpted hip drapes/swags, and a voluminous, fluted bell-shaped skirt finished with an ornate gold floral border around a scalloped hem. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and fully continuous with no floating geometry or artifacts.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it resembles a pleated circular flower or scalloped parasol, with radiating crimson skirt folds surrounding the rectangular neck opening, puffed shoulder sleeves, and central round finial.
blind.height_vs_figure: Stands roughly 4 feet tall (about three-quarters the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) with a wide skirt base roughly 3.5 to 4 feet in diameter.

notes: Skirt is wider than catalog estimate (1:1 width to height ratio due to full bell/crinoline skirt)
